about_short_description.short_description: QLife Pharma is a pharmaceutical firm that manufactures and supplies oral solids, liquids, hygiene, and other consumer health products.

product.name: Oral Solid Dosage Forms
product.description: Pharmaceutical tablets and capsules for various therapeutic uses including antihypertensives, antibiotics, analgesics, and more.

product.name: Oral Liquid Dosage Forms
product.description: Pharmaceutical syrups and suspensions for conditions like cough, allergies, and bronchial issues.

product.name: Semi-Solid Dosage Forms
product.description: Creams, ointments, and gels for burns, wounds, dry skin, pain relief, antifungal, and antiseptic applications.

product.name: Oral Hygiene Products
product.description: Mouthwashes designed for oral antiseptic and hygiene purposes.

product.name: Antiseptics and Hand Sanitizers
product.description: Liquid antiseptics and hand sanitizer gels in various packaging sizes for infection control.

product.name: Medical Supplies
product.description: Specialized gels such as USG coupling gel and urethral lubricating gel for medical procedures.
